accepted.reason: One flow, reported at four points: sitemap.xml URL (898) -> analyze_pages (3043) -> analyze_page (2832) -> open() at 2496 of the path returned by self.fix_applicator.map_url_to_local_path(). The traversal was real and was fixed in PR #331 inside that mapper (plugins/apply_fixes.py): '.'/'..' segments (raw or %2e) are refused, exact-name lookups take the name from os.listdir() so URL text never becomes path text, and the result must realpath under local_webserver (symlink escape refused). Re-verified 2026-11-12 against a test tree: /docs-v5/admin-guide/ and /docs-v5/intro/ still map to their files; /docs-v5/../../../../outside/secret, /docs-v5/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/x and a symlink out of the tree all return None. Snyk passes taint straight through the method call on self.fix_applicator, which it cannot resolve, so the check inside the mapper is invisible to it. Repeating the same confinement at the call site would only duplicate the mapper.

fixed_20261112.fix: Branch names, --since-date and commit hashes are now checked by local checked_branch/checked_since/checked_commit functions that rebuild the value from a fixed character table and refuse anything else (branch: no '..', '//', leading '-' or trailing '/', '.', '.lock'; commit: 40 or 64 hex digits). --since is passed as '--since=<date>': before, '--since-date=--output=x' was silently accepted. The old validate_refname regex used '$', so it also accepted a trailing newline, and it let 'a..b' and 'a/' through to git.

The branch becomes part of the post file name (photon-<branch>-monthly-YYYY-MM.md) and of the YAML front matter; it is now refused unless it is a plain name (letters, digits, . _ -, no '..'). --db-path/--output-dir are checked against a path character table. --sync-check used to open any file_path stored in the summaries table; it now only reads a path that names that row's post file and reports other rows under 'unexpected_path'. Post paths are built in one helper (post_path) shared by generate and export.

Removed. They were byte-identical, stale copies of .factory/skills/; the workflow (photon-commits-db.yml), tests, droids, SKILL.md files and generate_all_missing.sh all use the skills/ copies. The team README's usage block now points at the skills/ paths. This removes 7 of the 21 findings with no code change.

FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR is rebuilt from a path character table (exit 1 with a message otherwise). Posts are only read if their realpath lies inside content/blog, so a symlink in the blog tree no longer makes the hook read a file outside it.

--local-path is checked (realpath, path character table, must be a directory if it exists) right after argument parsing, before any GitHub API call or repository creation; before, a bad path was only noticed after the target repository had been created.
